statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail sits at the base of the watch band after an orderly Globex restart, with Stress elevated on a 2007-high 10-year yield.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The published danger window is the 24 September U.S. cash open from 13:30 to 15:00 UTC, where opening continuation from an aligned rates and energy backdrop is the structure that would deny retracement.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures reopen with a small orderly bounce after a session driven by a 2007-high 10-year yield
body: The Globex restart at 22:00 UTC has returned a live NQ price path after the maintenance halt, and the first prints are constructive rather than continuative. Nasdaq-100 futures trade 30,810.50, about 0.15% above the prior settle, inside a narrow 30,778.00 to 30,813.00 restart range with no extension attempt. That follows a risk-off but orderly 23 September cash session: the Nasdaq-100 closed 30,470.29, down 262.10 points or 0.85%, inside a 30,353.88 to 30,706.23 range and roughly 116 points above its low, so the index did not settle on the lows. Rates were the driver. The 10-year Treasury yield rose about 15 basis points to 5.11% after an intraday peak near 5.135%, its highest since 2007 and its largest one-day move since April 2025, while the 30-year touched 5.37%. S&P Global's flash composite PMI printed 58.4 against a 55.3 consensus, with services at 58.7 and manufacturing at 57.0, and input costs at their steepest since October 2022. Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr said further policy adjustments are likely to be needed, and October hike pricing moved to roughly 71%. Energy reinforced the same channel, with WTI near $92.69 and Brent close to $98. Latest-session context showed all seven tracked semiconductors lower while megacap participation was dispersed, with Microsoft, Meta and Tesla higher against declines in Alphabet, Broadcom and Amazon. Against that amplifier stack, the VIX at 15.18 remains low in absolute terms, the cash index closed well off its low, and the futures restart has bounced, so mean reversion is functioning. That combination supports elevated Stress with Tail held at the bottom of the watch band. The shared Finviz context file was 102 minutes old and partial this hour, with its futures and calendar sections unavailable, so it was treated as stale and was not used as current evidence; all levels above come from independently verified primary sources.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours divide at the 23 September U.S. data window. Through the overnight and European morning, Claude published Tail between 10 and 15 with Stress in the mid-30s while the Nasdaq-100 held a quiet uptrend and then a neutral range. The 14:00 UTC hour marked the regime change: the flash PMI beat, its steepest input-price reading since October 2022 and the accompanying yield surge pushed Tail to 25 and Stress to 54 in a trend-down assessment. Tail then settled back to 21-24 with Stress between 53 and 57 through the rest of the cash session and the maintenance halt, because the decline stayed orderly and retracements remained available rather than becoming one-way extension.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are shaped by an unresolved rates and energy backdrop rather than by an observed one-way equity path. The current hour has a live but young price path from the Globex restart, and it is constructive. Conditional risk then eases through the Asian session to an overnight floor, with the Tokyo cash open and the 07:00 UTC European cash and bond opens as the first two cross-asset confirmation checkpoints for whether the 2007-high U.S. 10-year is imported abroad. Risk rebuilds into the 24 September U.S. sequence: jobless claims at 12:30 UTC are modelled as whipsaw rather than sustained Tail, and the published conditional peak sits at the 13:30 UTC cash open, where opening-auction continuation from an aligned backdrop would be the structure that denies retracement. New Home Sales at 14:00 UTC falls inside the danger window, which closes at 15:00 UTC. Risk then decays through the U.S. midday and ticks up again into the power hour before the 20:00 UTC cash close and the 21:00 UTC maintenance halt. The Trump-Xi summit and its evening state dinner are a live headline channel into semiconductor and AI names across the European and U.S. hours. Every forecast hour beyond the current one describes a conditional path, not observed structure.
